regime_context: The detector shows narrow leadership in AI Compute & Optics (rank 1, trend-eligible, not crowded), with only 6 of 22 themes eligible. However, backtest for this market shows the absolute-trend gate did not reduce drawdown (mean-reverting whipsaw), so the trend discipline’s edge is absent here. The macro backdrop is dominated by AI and Geopolitics narratives with very high unscheduled surprises. Given a track record of 0/2 hits, any directional leans should be treated as low-conviction, experimental views.

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics is the prevailing momentum leader with the highest rank and trend eligibility. The trend structure is intact (durability 0.58, breadth 0.235). Given the gate’s lack of historical edge in this mean-reverting market, the call is highly conditional and low confidence; it relies on the trend persisting without a sharp reversal.
theses.dissent: The trend gate has historically failed to cut drawdown in China A-shares; a mean-reverting whipsaw could reverse AI Compute gains rapidly, especially given the macro surprise share of 93%.

falsifier.text: If the theme loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips to false) within 10 trading days, or durability drops below 0.4, the bullish thesis is invalidated.
